events.title: .NET Framework 1.0 released to manufacturing
events.summary: Microsoft shipped .NET Framework 1.0 RTM on January 15, 2002 — the CLR, class libraries, and managed runtime for Windows.
events.about: .NET Framework is Microsoft's managed platform — garbage-collected CLR, BCL class libraries, ASP.NET web stack, and ADO.NET data access. It powered enterprise Windows apps, Web Forms sites, WCF services, and later WPF desktops until .NET Core/.NET 5+ replaced it for cross-platform work.

narrative.whyChosen: .NET Framework defined Microsoft's post-COM development stack for two decades.
narrative.whyImportant: It unified C#, VB.NET, and other languages on one runtime with a shared library ecosystem.
narrative.problemSolved: Windows developers juggled COM, MFC, and ASP classic; .NET offered one managed platform for desktop and web.
